$comment: Pack Rat packrat-paths.json v1: the file the installer writes beside the game scripts it installs (app/installer.mts's writePathsFile), naming the data folder they write into, and which the Razor Enhanced README has the player write by hand for a client on another machine. The scripts' data_dir() (the `paths` fragments in adapters/_shared/) reads dataDir, through os.path.expanduser; an empty or missing one, or no file, means $PACKRAT_DATA, else ~/.pack-rat. The app reads it back for Setup's data-folder check (checkScriptsDataDir), at most 64 KiB, comparing it with its own data folder. Restricted to the keyword subset app/schema/validate.mts supports. The shared cases are app/fixtures/contract-cases/packrat-paths.json.

dataDir.$comment: absolute, or starting with ~; an empty one means the default
